description: Run a test stage against a live dev session: state expectations and read one verdict for each, instead of reading a blob and hand-rolling the judgement. Every expectation comes back pass, fail or inconclusive, where inconclusive means this platform cannot cover the question today and the verdict says what would settle it. An inconclusive check is never a pass. Start the session with extension_dev; use extension_inspect or extension_logs when you want the raw reading instead of a verdict.

browser.description: Session browser; defaults to this project's live session

expect.description: One object per expectation, each { assert: <check id>, ...args }. background-worker-booted: no args. surface-rendered: surface (popup, options, sidebar, newtab, history, bookmarks), optional selector and minNodes. content-script-injected: url. storage-key-present: key, optional area (default local), equals, context. console-errors-empty: optional context (array), since (seq cursor), ignore (substrings).

projectPath.description: Extension project root (needs a live dev session)

name: extension_assert
